subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until stable-package, WebChat/iOS, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-run proof are correlated, or should maintainers split it under narrower open trackers now?
rationale: The current evidence spans multiple partially fixed or still-open tracks, and automation cannot safely decide whether the remaining work is one incident, several canonical bugs, or a stable-release communication problem.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers correlate the stable package, WebChat/iOS dispatch, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-run recovery slices against the reported all-channel symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the remaining WebChat, WhatsApp replay, package-parity, and stuck-run pieces under existing canonical issues or PRs, then close this only after those links preserve the user evidence.

options.title: Treat As Package-Parity Only
options.body: Close under the package-parity fix only if maintainers decide the reply-session stable artifact mismatch fully explains the all-channel silence and duplicate-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers correlate the stable package, WebChat/iOS dispatch, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-run recovery slices against the reported all-channel symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses stable/beta release proof and channel message-delivery policy, and current related discussion already routes the replay/delivery review to this person.
